fields.statement: The build guide and the review guide's non-qa checks tell verifiers and checks to test runs with fakes only, never real Rex, agents or gh; the review guide's qa check runs the built binary hands-on, since fakes alone do not count for it
fields.wording: Build and review guides say to test runs with fakes only, never real Rex, agents or gh, except the review qa check, which runs the built binary hands-on: the change set's intent, the agent's wording (assumed, would have escalated)
